title: Rule file
description: Shape shared by rules/submission-rules.json, rules/composition-rules.json and a profile's rules-local.json. Product rules carry `why` and `default`; a local rule usually carries `origin` (the user's own words) instead.

id.description: SR-xx for submission rules, CR-xx for composition rules, any PREFIX-xx for local rules (LR-xx suggested).

default.description: Product rules only. false means the rule is a style preference and runs only when its id is in profile.json settings.rules_on.

why.description: One neutral sentence on the failure the rule prevents.

origin.description: Local rules only: the user's own words, and when, that created the rule.
